non_duplicate_boundary: Unlike cycle 272 material hysteresis, this monitor requires a living cell to copy a spatial cortical arrangement through growth and division. Unlike cycle 273 protein-state memory, the carrier must be an organized geometry rather than one molecular conformation or abundance state.
question: Does a primary ciliate perturbation, grafting or microsurgery experiment show that one source-identical local cortical update and copy rule learns from an unlabeled transient history a reusable spatial representation that improves an unseen unrelated morphogenetic task beyond self-templating of the imposed geometry, genomic change, selection, ordinary damage repair and experimenter-authored target shape at full cost?

candidate_audits.mechanism: clonal propagation of cortical row orientation and row-number corticotype
candidate_audits.observation: Experimentally introduced or naturally isolated cortical arrangements persist for many divisions independently of nuclear genotype, while some variants are lost or drift toward a genotype-dependent stability center.
candidate_audits.reason: This is genuine non-DNA spatial inheritance, but it copies an imposed or pre-existing geometry and does not learn or transfer a rule to an unrelated unseen function.

candidate_audits.mechanism: local polarity inheritance controlling adjacent organelle placement
candidate_audits.observation: Quasi-surgical 180-degree rotation of Tetrahymena ciliary rows reverses newly formed local structures and moves the contractile-vacuole pore from the normal left side to the right side of the inverted row.
candidate_audits.reason: This is the closest relational effect, but the experimenter authors the polarity and a fixed local coordinate rule determines the downstream structure; there is no observation learning, unseen-task improvement or full-cost comparison.

candidate_audits.mechanism: cortical boundary and discontinuity induction of oral morphogenesis
candidate_audits.observation: Stentor grafts and persistent heteropolar cortical discontinuities create organizer-like boundaries that induce basal-body assembly and oral development, whereas healing homopolar grafts rarely do.
candidate_audits.reason: The interventions directly construct the spatial trigger and recruit an evolved morphogenetic program; they do not train a reusable representation or show inherited cross-task gain.

candidate_audits.mechanism: Mob1-dependent maintenance of a single anterior-posterior axis
candidate_audits.observation: Mob1 RNAi produces progressive disproportion and multiple posterior-like poles, while control RNAi and tubulin perturbations distinguish aspects of global patterning and cortical integrity.
candidate_audits.reason: The factor intervention identifies frozen evolved patterning machinery, not the write, copy and read of an experience-learned spatial state or cross-function transfer.

candidate_audits.mechanism: ciliary-force-responsive striated-fiber length and basal-body reorientation
candidate_audits.observation: Striated fibers reversibly lengthen or shorten with ciliary force; DisAp restoration and Cro1 loss/rescue causally link fiber length to basal-body orientation and array stability.
candidate_audits.reason: This is factor-specific homeostatic force adaptation during the current condition, not persistent history-specific learning through divisions or transfer to an unrelated function.
